headline: Callum's Cape Breached as Mooring County Meatgrinder Intensifies
war_summary: Combat across the front has pivoted sharply following the quiet consolidation of Nevish Line, where Colonial forces now hold all eight strongholds as skirmishing drops to a crawl. In its place, Callum's Cape has erupted into frantic action, suffering over twenty-five hundred casualties in two hours as Colonial troops seized Scouts Jest to breach the previously solid Warden sector. Mooring County endures the heaviest sustained clash on the map, devouring more than four thousand casualties in two hours amidst accelerating gunfire, even as lines around The Wind Hills hold steady. To the east, Marban Hollow witnessed five swift base turnovers in the past two hours centered on Checkpoint Bua, leaving the territory divided three Warden, three Colonial, and two bases reduced to no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse registered two base shifts at the wire, maintaining three ruined positions, while Linn of Mercy and Stlican Shelf continue to absorb steady, heavy casualty rates without fresh territorial turnover.
